tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search upcoming EventWave public event records by city, category, date window, and keyword. Returns evidence state and original source URLs. Read-only.

tools.name: get_eventwave_promotion_offers
tools.description: List current EventWave paid promotion packages and their evidence/payment boundaries. Read-only; creates no checkout, invoice, charge, or payment obligation.

tools.name: prepare_event_promotion_handoff
tools.description: Prepare a review URL for a selected EventWave promotion package. This does not create checkout, invoice, charge, entitlement, or payment obligation. The human must review the page and explicitly start checkout there.

tools.name: prepare_event_promotion_checkout
tools.description: After the human explicitly agrees to pay for a selected EventWave promotion package, prepare the secure checkout. Checkout creation is not payment proof and source review still controls public placement.

tools.name: get_eventwave_promotion_status
tools.description: Read promotion order state and independently verify payment when a checkout session exists. Read-only from the agent perspective; may advance internal verified payment state.

tools.name: get_eventwave_capabilities
tools.description: Describe EventWave machine-facing discovery, promotion, evidence, and payment boundaries.
